theorem norm_mainPartL_le {α x δ M D : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hMδ : |δ| * M ≤ x / 2) (hMD : M ≤ D)
    (hD4 : D ≤ x / 4) (hDe : D ≤ x / rexp 1) :
    ‖mainPartL α x M q‖ ≤
      x / (2 * q) * minInv c₀ (π * δ) * |muSum M q (2 * q) fun m => Real.log (x / (m * q))| +
        x / (2 * q) * ‖fourier (fun t => Real.log t * eta2 t) (-(δ / 2))‖ *
          |muSum M q (2 * q) fun _ => 1| +
        c₀ * (1 / 2 - 2 / π ^ 2) *
          (D ^ 2 / (4 * q * x) * Real.log (rexp (1 / 2) * x / D) + 1 / rexp 1) :=

note: Lean uses the odd-n main term x/2q, min(1,c₀/(πδ)²), (m,2q) = 1, (log·η)^(−δ/2); the printed all-n term is up to 4× too small for |δ| ≳ 1. Erratum: (4.40) prints the all-n main term: x/q, min(1, c0/(2 pi delta)^2), (m,q)=1 and hat(log eta)(-delta). (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_4_40.py`).
